description: This PHP source file defines a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM view class 'DocumentsViewExtdoc' that handles external document search and display, including integration with external APIs, user session validation, and rendering search results in different contexts (popup or full page). It manages external API interactions, user login validation, and template rendering.

classes.name: DocumentsViewExtdoc
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView to handle external document search via APIs, display results, and manage user session validation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view with optional bean and view object mappings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the main logic of fetching external document data, validating sessions, handling popups, and rendering the template with the search results.
